title: Jack and the Shaking Screen
synopsis: Jack watches a screening machine send big and little stones to different places. His first guess about how it works is wrong, and a simple sorting demonstration helps him understand.
continuity_state: Before: At the stone yard, the group has observed a primary crusher that makes large quarry rock smaller and sends it onward by belt. The finished material must still be sorted before it can be delivered. After: Jack has seen a vibrating screen separate crushed stone into grades, with oversized pieces routed for further processing. Mr. Fred has shown sealed jars of coarse and fine material at the visitor desk. Jack has added a drawing of screens, holes and paths to his existing blue notebook. The park patch remains unrepaired.
